queries:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT college_id, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS cnt
  FROM player_college
  GROUP BY college_id
),
s AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM c
)
SELECT AVG(c.cnt) AS mean_count,
       AVG(c.cnt * 1.0 / s.total) AS mean_share,
       AVG(c.cnt - s.avg_cnt) AS mean_diff
FROM c, s
WHERE c.cnt > s.avg_cnt;
SELECT college_id
FROM player_college
GROUP BY college_id
HAVING college_id IS NOT NULL
   AND COUNT(*) > (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id));
SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) FROM player_college)) FROM (SELECT college_id, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS cnt FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id);
